source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Gather basic information: date, time, and location of the accident.
3. Note the names, job titles, and contact details of the individuals involved.
4. Record the sequence of events leading to the accident in detail.
5. Document the precise nature of the injury or damage.
6. Include witness statements, if available.
7. Take photographs or sketches of the accident scene for visual documentation.
8. Note any immediate action taken to address the situation.
9. Provide details about medical treatment and the attending professional, if applicable.
10. Record the impact on the workplace, including any work stoppages or equipment damage.
11. Complete all necessary forms (OHS incident report, Workers' Compensation forms, etc.) as required by your specific jurisdiction or company policies.
12. Ensure confidentiality and privacy of personal information according to relevant laws and regulations.
13. Forward the report to relevant authorities or departments within the organization.
